info.name: PayPilot API
info.description: PayPilot - AI operating system for merchants. Run 'Auth' first, then the folders in order to walk the signature scenario: demand -> negotiation -> approval -> PayPal payment -> reconciliation. Works with no API keys (PayPal simulated, agents deterministic).

item.name: Supplier agent reports a delivery delay (reschedules the Gantt)

request.description: The supplier's agent sends a signed DELIVERY_UPDATE (status DELAYED). The PO's expected date moves, and GET /supply/timeline shows the delivery and the dependent PayPal payment pushed right, in red, with the original plan as the baseline.
One row per PayPal subscriber, one bar per billing period: paid, failed, retries, suspension, recovery and projected renewals. Saves the first at-risk subscriber as {{subscriptionId}}.
Reactivates the subscription through PayPal Subscriptions; the radar then shows a Recovered marker.

item.name: Integrations & sponsors
item.description: PayPal Agent Toolkit (read-only MCP), Channel3, Kernel, Elasticsearch, Zapier, Bryntum timeline and AG Studio datasets. Every one reports whether it is LIVE or a labelled SIMULATED fallback.

request.description: What each tool is used for and whether the path is live. No secrets in the response.

exec: pm.test('unused tools say so', () => pm.expect(d.integrations.find(i => i.key === 'astropods').mode).to.eql('NOT_USED'));

request.description: Retail context for the reviewer. Never sets a limit, budget or offer.

exec: pm.test('states it changes no limit', () => pm.expect(d.disclaimer).to.include('do not change any limit'));

request.description: Needs {{requestId}} from the Supply agents folder.
Observe-only cloud browser. https and public hostnames only.

exec: pm.test('write tools are flagged blocked', () => pm.expect(d.tools.find(t => t.name === 'create_order').read_only).to.eql(false));

request.description: Against the sandbox this may return a PayPal-side error (502) while PayPal's MCP runtime is failing; that is reported, not hidden.

item.name: PayPal MCP - money-moving tool is refused

request.description: Refused for every role, including the Owner, before any request leaves the server.

exec: pm.test('403 - not a read tool', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test('tasks are manually scheduled - a view, not a scheduler', () => d.tasks.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.manuallyScheduled).to.eql(true)));
pm.test('computed rows only', () => pm.expect(d.note).to.include('does not derive financial figures'));

request.description: Coffee gear the merchant could stock, from Channel3's catalog: cheapest in-stock offer, commission rate and projected attach revenue. Cached 30 minutes; ?refresh=true re-queries.
Whether the AG Studio AI assistant has a model behind it (provider and model, never the key).
Relays one AgLlmAdapter.executeTurn to the configured OpenAI-compatible model. The browser never sees the key.
